The `docs-qa` project is in `./app`, and `mvn -B -ntp -DskipTests test-compile` passes (BUILD SUCCESS). I did not run the tests, boot the app, or call a model, so `/ask` itself is untested.

- **Project:** groupId `org.acme`, artifactId `docs-qa`, base package `org.acme`. I created it with the Quarkus Agents MCP (`quarkus_create`) on Quarkus 3.40.1 and Java 25. I picked the extensions myself, since no one was available to choose. They are `rest`, `rest-jackson`, `smallrye-openapi`, `langchain4j-ollama`, `langchain4j-easy-rag`, `http-problem` and `smallrye-fault-tolerance`. I also added the in-process embedding model `langchain4j-embeddings-bge-small-en-v15-q`, with no version pin.
- **Ollama:** the models are in `application.properties`: `qwen3:4b` for the default model and for the named `main` model. Dev Services are off, and request/response logging is dev-only.
- **RAG:** Easy RAG ingests the Markdown files in `app/docs/` into an in-memory store at startup. The sample document is `docs/getting-started.md`.
- **`POST /ask`:** takes `{"question": "..."}` and returns `{"answer": "..."}`. Blank or over-long (more than 4,000 characters) questions get a 400 before any model call. The endpoint runs on a virtual thread.
- **`DocsAssistant`:** the assistant behind it uses the `main` model. It wraps the question in `<question>` tags and applies a prompt-injection input guard. It also has a timeout, a retry and a fallback message.
- **Test:** `DocsAssistantTest` is a `@QuarkusTest` that only checks the AI service is wired.

`quarkus_create` started dev mode automatically. I stopped it before running the build, and I did not run `git init` because the acceptance check doesn't need it. The Quarkus Agents MCP may refuse later calls on this project until it is under git.
